_readme: THE ONE PLACE competitor data lives. tools/compare_table.py renders it into
the <tbody> of the comparison table in src/index.html and into the dated
footnote (cmp.note) in assets/js/i18n.js; check_site.py fails if either is
stale, and warns when checked_on is more than 90 days old.
Cell values: "yes" = the maker states the feature on its own site;
"premium" / "pro" = stated as part of that paid plan; "gfit" = Google Fit
rather than Health Connect; a price string; null = NOT stated on the
maker's site on the check date (rendered as —, never as ✗ — absence is
not something we can confirm). A guess never goes in this file.
Row labels are the cmp.r* keys in i18n.js. Fotocal's own column is fact
the founder owns; the price there must match the subscription page.

checked_at.Cal AI: https://www.calai.app/ · https://www.calai.app/faq (maker's site; no price published there)

note.en: Competitor columns show what each maker states on its own website, checked on {date}: ✓ or a plan name means the maker states it, — means it is not stated there. Prices are the makers' published yearly prices in US dollars and can change. Fotocal is Android-only for now.
note.es: Las columnas de la competencia recogen lo que cada fabricante declara en su propia web, comprobado el {date}: ✓ o el nombre de un plan significa que el fabricante lo declara; — significa que no consta. Los precios son los anuales publicados por cada fabricante, en dólares, y pueden cambiar. Por ahora Fotocal es solo para Android.

rows.why: Cal AI: photo scan is the product. MFP: Meal Scan is a Premium feature (English only). Yazio: AI food tracking is part of Pro.
Cal AI lists barcode scanning. MFP: barcode scanner Premium-only since Oct 2022. Yazio: barcode is in the free tier (Pro adds AI scanner, analyses, ratings, activity, recipes).
Restaurant menu scanning: none of the three states it.
Cal AI offers typed 'describe', not voice, on its site. MFP: Voice Log is Premium, English only. Yazio: only Siri Shortcuts on iOS, nothing for Android.
AI chat coach: none of the three states it.
Health score with swaps: not stated. Yazio's 'smart food ratings' (Pro) is a different thing and is not counted.
MFP: Nutrient Dashboard is Premium. Yazio: vitamins & minerals are Pro. Cal AI: not stated.
Mood & habit journal: none of the three states it.
MFP: weekly progress views are for Premium members. Yazio: weekly/monthly evaluation is Pro-only (free has daily). Cal AI: not stated.
Cal AI: connects to Google Fit on Android (Health Connect not named). MFP: Health Connect documented. Yazio: Health Connect documented, automatic activity tracking is a Pro feature.
MFP and Yazio both list Spanish among app languages. Cal AI: languages not stated.

MFP: Premium $79.99/yr (Premium+ $99.99/yr). Cal AI: no price on its site. Yazio: prices vary by country and no yearly figure is published on the pages reachable; the ≈$44 and $47.90 the table used to show are gone.
